comment: dig.c dighole() 966-968 and 977-982: a debug dwarven Archeologist level-teleports to the castle (this seed leaves it unflipped, with the hero in the west maze), reads a wished scroll of magic mapping and travels to the land west of the raised drawbridge, puts on a wished ring of levitation and floats onto the bridge's span square. A wished 'ice' there changes only the drawbridgemask (DB_ICE; objnam.c wizterrainwish() 3672-3674, since the span is a drawbridge), so dighole() reaches the DRAWBRIDGE_UP branch when a wished wand of digging is zapped down: fillholetyp() finds the moat beside it and 'As you dig, the hole fills with water!' (liquid_flow()). Castle monsters' killing blows are refused at Die?.
